description: Import IDs into list. Add property or person ids to this list, matching the list's source_type. Records already on the list stay, so importing again adds to it. Runs asynchronously: the response is this list with status `building`; poll `GET /v1/lists/{list_id}` until status is `completed`. Requires user approval and confirmed=true before changes or credit use. Writes are never retried automatically.

add_as_prospects.description: Whether the records filed here also become prospects in the workspace. Default true; pass false to build the list without tracking its records as prospects.

items.description: A record id: a positive integer, or the same id as a decimal string. Person ids can exceed the JSON safe integer range (2^53 - 1), so pass those as strings.

source_type.description: What the ids are. Defaults to the list's own source_type; any other value is rejected.

confirmed.description: Set true only after the user approves this change or credit use.

name: dealmachine_post_lists_list_id_import
